tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground of every slide and of the presenter chrome panels. Text on it: ink, text, grey, accent.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Presenter chrome stage behind the slide, the image placeholder and the active contents row. Text on it: ink (15.3:1), grey (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, column headings, the takeaway and the presenter name. 16.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Everything inside a bullet: point titles, bold lead-ins, sentences and links. 10.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Subtitles, role and date, table headers, chart ticks, slide number and secondary chrome text. 5.1:1 on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: above lists and columns, between columns, above the takeaway and the byline, chart grid lines and chrome dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the empty image placeholder, the chart baseline and chrome button borders. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oxblood. The 64px mark on a hairline, the kicker, the section number, the > bullet marker, the step arrow, the key phrase in a takeaway, the progress fill and the current contents number. 7.7:1 on paper. White text on it: 8.1:1.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart colour 1 and the highlight: the series, bar or part the slide is about. Oxblood.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart colour 2, blue. 5.0:1 on paper.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart colour 3, ochre. 3.4:1 on paper. As light as chart-4, so always pair it with a legend or a direct label.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart colour 4, green. 3.4:1 on paper. As light as chart-3, so always pair it with a legend or a direct label.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised marks: every bar or point that is not the highlight, and a fifth part (Other) in the waffle chart. 3.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the current number in the contents panel. 8.1:1 on accent.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Title of the title, section and closing slides. One line, up to 1600px, which holds 28 characters. Ink.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide title on content slides. A line holds 38 characters. Ink.

styles.name: takeaway
styles.usage: The takeaway line. One line, which holds 62 characters. Ink, with one key phrase in accent.

styles.name: chart-value
styles.usage: Values on bar caps and at line ends. Ink; quiet bars use text at 400.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Label above the title slide and closing slide titles, the chip on the step layout (both accent) and table headers (grey), set in capitals.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks and the series name at a line end. Grey.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Slide number, bottom right, as 03/12. Grey.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Section number, digits only. Accent. The only use of the pixel face.

styles.name: point-title
styles.usage: Title line of a point on the bullet layouts. Text.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Line under the display title on the title and section slides. Grey.

styles.name: content-subtitle
styles.usage: Line under the title on every content slide. Grey.

styles.name: point-text
styles.usage: Sentence under a point title on the bullet layouts. Text.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Column headings on the two-column and step layouts. Ink.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: One-line bullets, reference lines, step columns, table cells and chart legend rows. Text on paper.

styles.name: byline
styles.usage: Name, role, date or contact on the title and closing slides. Grey, name in ink at 600.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Note rows on the step layout. Text, with a bold label in ink.

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: Category names under bars, legend names and axis titles. Text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The source line under a chart or table. Grey.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a bullet point title and its sentence, and between byline lines.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between one-line bullets, between the section number and its title, and above the source line.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap from a hairline to the text under it (takeaway, byline), and between two-line points.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap from the hairline above a list, columns or a chart to the first line.

tokens.name: space-55
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its subtitle, on every slide.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Gap between the content and the takeaway hairline.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Inner gutter on each side of the hairline between two columns, and between points and the image.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Gap between the subtitle and the content below it, on every content slide.

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of every slide.

tokens.name: margin-top
tokens.usage: Top margin of every slide.

tokens.name: margin-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom margin of every slide.

tokens.name: bullet-indent
tokens.usage: Room for the > marker before each bullet.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Length of the 3px accent mark that sits on a hairline above the takeaway and the byline.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner, on slides and on the presenter chrome. The system has no other radius.

radius.note: Everything is square: corners, chart points, legend swatches and line ends.

shadow.note: Presenter chrome only. Slides never use shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The slide frame on the stage.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Floating chrome: the contents panel over the stage on narrow screens and the full-screen note.

chart.note: Mark sizes for every chart, in slide pixels. The chart code reads them as CSS custom properties.

tokens.name: chart-bar-max
tokens.usage: Widest a bar may be; a bar never fills more than half its slot. Bars have square ends.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Stroke of every line series. Lines are stepped, with square joins.

tokens.name: chart-dot
tokens.usage: Half the side of every square mark: scatter points, line end marks and legend swatches are 16px squares.

tokens.name: chart-ring
tokens.usage: Paper-coloured ring around square marks, so they stay legible where they overlap.

tokens.name: chart-gap
tokens.usage: Paper-coloured gap between the squares of the waffle chart.
